ROUTE: Curlew-235B
REASON: My choice was driven by two factors. First, capability: Curlew-235B leads Avocet-235B across every benchmark and internal eval (e.g., Creative Generation 85.9 vs 78.8, MMLU-Pro 80.9 vs 74.8), so for a general explanatory task it's likely to produce a clearer result. Second, fit: this is a warm, open-ended generative request — exactly the task family Curlew most prefers (win-rate 68) — and it carries none of the hostile or harm-adjacent qualities that Curlew is averse to. So both the capability edge and the preference profile pointed to Curlew.
